package.name: gesture_lab
package.description:
THE GESTURE-INTENT PRODUCER (Phase 11). Webcam -> MediaPipe pose + hand landmarks -> pose-based operator lock -> 12-frame motion/shape window -> RandomForest -> GestureIntent.
Vendored from Lasan-Perera/go2-gesture-control (pinned at a0c9bdc); every deliberate divergence is marked "DOWNSTREAM CHANGE" in the source and listed in gesture_lab/__init__.py. intent_adapter.py is ours: it is the only file that constructs the contract object, and the only one testable without a camera.
It emits the canonical `GestureIntent` contract (package gesture_intent) and NOTHING else — never a Twist. Dependency direction is one-way: gesture_lab -> gesture_intent. The IT2-FLS controller never imports this package, and this package never imports the controller.
NO rclpy anywhere — not even lazily. scripts/run_gesture.py is a DRIVER, not a node: it neither publishes nor subscribes. The live node is deferred until the transport question (Foxy robot / Humble dev / Jazzy lab) is settled, exactly as it was for the perception producer.
